title: Process deviation: the contract was amended out-of-process for #806/#807 (solo edit in an execution session, no phase-1a/1b composition, no review round) and committed on operator content-approval alone — reverted; re-entering the design phase properly

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content:
THE DEVIATION (recorded; the record stands per the ungated-work discipline).

WHAT: contract amendments #806 (routing format-carry + invariant-first principle) and #807 (terminal-output-safety requirement + shared-primitive boundary raise) were authored and committed directly to the ratified governing document (.design/agent-first-vsdd-toolkit.md) by a single agent inside a Layer-3 EXECUTION session, on operator content-approval alone.

WHY IT IS A DEVIATION — two ways, one root:
1. VSDD process: a spec amendment is a re-entry into phase 1a/1b — authored under a declared composition, run through cold review lenses, THEN ratified. Operator approval is the phase EXIT (the ratification gate), never a substitute for the phase's composition and review. The amendment was inlined into execution with neither; the earlier amendments (#730, #739) were legitimate precisely because they ran under the phase-1c spec-review loop with rounds and dispositions.
2. Domain ownership (operator guidance): spec-contract changes are the Solution Owner's to author; the prose and register are Documentation Reviewer / Technical Writer's. A solo agent editing the contract's normative text and register bypassed all three owning domains.

ROOT: this is the same collapse the whole session has been catching — an owned, reviewed process skipped in favor of solo-act-on-approval. #806 was findings orphaned by skipping phase 4; this is an amendment orphaned by skipping phase 1a/1b. Third occurrence of the pattern this session.

REMEDIATION (operator-directed, path A): reverted in commit 9b451099 (contract restored to 25851ca0; mdatron clean). The drafted text is preserved on #806/#807 and re-enters phase 1a/1b as the DRAFT — no drafting lost, but it now gets the composition and cold review it skipped, with operator ratification as the true exit. #806 and #807 reopened for that re-entry. The deviation record stands regardless of the redo.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: REMEDIATION COMPLETE (the deviation record stands): the out-of-process contract edits were reverted (9b451099) and the amendment re-entered its full owned process — draft via the design affordance, four-lens cold review, terminal + final verify, operator ratification — landing properly as #810 (8c9aaeda). Two standing conduct rules captured in memory (route findings before fixing; spec amendments are owned and reviewed). The deviation itself remains recorded per the ungated-work discipline. Closing the remediation.
